04/23/2025
Claimant reported a rear-end impact while the insured vehicle was parked in a lot, and the claim was opened the
same day with a request for a rental.
06/26/2025
The driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss. Nothing suggests the
damage happened before the coverage started.
06/27/2025
Claimant is represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office. Future requests will be
routed accordingly.
06/30/2025
Responding officer's notes place the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. No witness account, photographs or
separate report of the impact have been located.
07/22/2025
Inspection of the vehicle shows damage to the rear bumper and tail lamp housing. No earlier damage to the vehicle is
known from prior claims or inspections.
07/30/2025
Repair estimate has been received, but it is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage came from this impact or
from other causes.
09/03/2025
Claimant's initial statement was recorded by phone. A follow-up interview added a few minor details about position
and speed, but the core account stayed the same.
09/25/2025
Medical records show a neck and back strain, which is a plausible injury for a collision of this type. Claimant was
referred for physical therapy.
09/30/2025
Prior records show treatment to the same body area within the last two years. That earlier condition appears to add to
the current complaints and will be considered in evaluating the injury.
11/23/2025
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. Latest therapy notes describe reduced
pain and better range of motion.
12/01/2025
File reviewed and sent to the bodily injury unit for evaluation. Liability and damage questions remain open pending
the repair review and the claimant's counsel's response.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
